title: Nutty Tender Polish Fish Dumplings
description: Cozy, creamy dumplings with a nutty almond base and fragrant massaman curry, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch.
instructions: In a bowl combine the flaked cod, massaman curry paste, salt, pepper, and soy sauce; mix until the fish is thoroughly coated.
In a separate bowl whisk the egg, then add the rice flour, almond butter, warmed sesame oil, and chopped cilantro; fold until a smooth, thick batter forms—add a splash of water if it’s too dense.
Gently fold the fish mixture into the batter, ensuring an even distribution of fish throughout.
Heat a non‑stick skillet over medium heat and lightly oil with a neutral oil.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter onto the skillet, forming 3 cm rounds; let them cook 3‑4 minutes until the edges set and the bottom turns golden.
Carefully flip each dumpling and cook another 3‑4 minutes until cooked through and the interior is opaque.
Transfer the dumplings to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Optionally, drizzle with a squeeze of lime juice and garnish with extra cilantro.
Serve hot for a comforting, nutty fish dumpling experience.
